signature_difference_explanation.conclusion: Within each arm, across 7 clean processes, the name-free canonical partition-graph node set and the canonical hash of every one of the 660 fetched outputs are identical; only the multiplicity of 11 canonical node classes (Const / Identity / RealDiv / Reshape / Tile on GPU) differs, each present at least once in every process. The executed-signature count difference is therefore a difference in how many structurally identical duplicate nodes survive the classic graph optimizer (a runtime graph-rewrite difference), not a difference in graph structure as built or in the mathematical computation. This is consistent with non-deterministic common-subexpression elimination / constant folding in the classic optimizer; that mechanism is not verified. It does not make the numerical results equal.
